introduction: This roadmap is designed to guide learners through a comprehensive journey of learning C programming — starting from basic syntax and environment setup, progressing through core concepts, data structures, memory management, and advanced programming techniques. It is structured into multiple stages with clear milestones and outcomes.

stages.title: Stage 1: Getting Started with C
stages.description: Set up the development environment and understand the basics of the C language.

items.name: 1.1 Introduction to C & Environment Setup
items.description:
Learning Outcomes: Understand the history and importance of C, install GCC/Clang, set up IDE (Code::Blocks/VS Code).
Time Commitment: 3-5 hours
Difficulty: Easy

items.name: 1.2 First C Program (Hello World)
items.description:
Learning Outcomes: Write and run your first program, understand structure of a C program (headers, main function).
Time Commitment: 2-3 hours
Difficulty: Easy

items.name: 1.3 Compiling & Debugging
items.description:
Learning Outcomes: Learn compilation process, errors vs. warnings, debugging basics using gdb.
Time Commitment: 4-6 hours
Difficulty: Easy

stages.title: Stage 2: C Fundamentals
stages.description: Learn the building blocks of C programming.

items.name: 2.1 Variables, Data Types & Constants
items.description:
Learning Outcomes: Declare and use variables, constants, and understand type modifiers.
Time Commitment: 5-7 hours
Difficulty: Easy

items.name: 2.2 Operators & Expressions
items.description:
Learning Outcomes: Use arithmetic, relational, logical, bitwise, and assignment operators.
Time Commitment: 6-8 hours
Difficulty: Easy

items.name: 2.3 Input & Output (printf, scanf, getchar, putchar)
items.description:
Learning Outcomes: Master basic I/O functions in C.
Time Commitment: 4-6 hours
Difficulty: Easy

stages.title: Stage 3: Control Flow
stages.description: Understand conditional statements and loops to control program execution.

items.name: 3.1 Conditional Statements (if, else, switch)
items.description:
Learning Outcomes: Apply decision-making constructs.
Time Commitment: 5-7 hours
Difficulty: Medium

items.name: 3.2 Loops (for, while, do-while)
items.description:
Learning Outcomes: Use iteration effectively to repeat tasks.
Time Commitment: 6-8 hours
Difficulty: Medium

items.name: 3.3 Break & Continue
items.description:
Learning Outcomes: Control loop execution flow.
Time Commitment: 3-4 hours
Difficulty: Easy

stages.title: Stage 4: Functions & Modular Programming
stages.description: Break down problems into reusable functions.

items.name: 4.1 Defining & Calling Functions
items.description:
Learning Outcomes: Create and call functions, pass parameters.
Time Commitment: 6-8 hours
Difficulty: Medium

items.name: 4.2 Scope & Storage Classes
items.description:
Learning Outcomes: Understand local, global, static, extern variables.
Time Commitment: 4-6 hours
Difficulty: Medium

items.name: 4.3 Recursion
items.description:
Learning Outcomes: Implement recursive algorithms (factorial, Fibonacci, etc.).
Time Commitment: 6-9 hours
Difficulty: Hard

stages.title: Stage 5: Arrays & Strings
stages.description: Learn to work with collections of data and manipulate strings.

items.name: 5.1 Arrays (1D & 2D)
items.description:
Learning Outcomes: Declare, initialize, traverse, and manipulate arrays.
Time Commitment: 7-9 hours
Difficulty: Medium

items.name: 5.2 Strings & Character Arrays
items.description:
Learning Outcomes: Handle strings, use string.h library functions.
Time Commitment: 7-10 hours
Difficulty: Medium

items.name: 5.3 Multi-dimensional Arrays
items.description:
Learning Outcomes: Work with matrices and tables.
Time Commitment: 8-10 hours
Difficulty: Medium

stages.title: Stage 6: Pointers & Memory Management
stages.description: Master pointers and dynamic memory allocation.

items.name: 6.1 Basics of Pointers
items.description:
Learning Outcomes: Declare, dereference, and manipulate pointers.
Time Commitment: 8-10 hours
Difficulty: Hard

items.name: 6.2 Pointers & Arrays
items.description:
Learning Outcomes: Explore pointer arithmetic, relation with arrays.
Time Commitment: 6-8 hours
Difficulty: Hard

items.name: 6.3 Dynamic Memory Allocation
items.description:
Learning Outcomes: malloc, calloc, realloc, free.
Time Commitment: 8-10 hours
Difficulty: Hard

stages.title: Stage 7: Structures, Unions & Enums
stages.description: Learn how to organize and represent complex data.

items.name: 7.1 Structures
items.description:
Learning Outcomes: Create and use structures.
Time Commitment: 6-8 hours
Difficulty: Medium

items.name: 7.2 Nested Structures & Arrays of Structures
items.description:
Learning Outcomes: Handle complex data representation.
Time Commitment: 6-9 hours
Difficulty: Medium

items.name: 7.3 Unions & Enums
items.description:
Learning Outcomes: Use unions for memory sharing, enums for readable constants.
Time Commitment: 4-6 hours
Difficulty: Medium

stages.title: Stage 8: File Handling
stages.description: Learn how to store and retrieve data using files.

items.name: 8.1 File Pointers & Modes
items.description:
Learning Outcomes: fopen, fclose, read, write files.
Time Commitment: 6-8 hours
Difficulty: Medium

items.name: 8.2 Working with Binary & Text Files
items.description:
Learning Outcomes: Handle structured data with files.
Time Commitment: 8-10 hours
Difficulty: Hard

stages.title: Stage 9: Advanced Topics
stages.description: Deep dive into advanced C programming concepts.

items.name: 9.1 Preprocessors & Macros
items.description:
Learning Outcomes: #define, #include, conditional compilation.
Time Commitment: 5-7 hours
Difficulty: Hard

items.name: 9.2 Command-line Arguments
items.description:
Learning Outcomes: Use argc and argv in programs.
Time Commitment: 4-6 hours
Difficulty: Medium

items.name: 9.3 Error Handling & Defensive Programming
items.description:
Learning Outcomes: Prevent runtime errors, handle edge cases.
Time Commitment: 6-8 hours
Difficulty: Hard

stages.title: Stage 10: Data Structures in C
stages.description: Implement and practice common data structures in C.

items.name: 10.1 Linked Lists
items.description:
Learning Outcomes: Singly, doubly, and circular linked lists.
Time Commitment: 10-12 hours
Difficulty: Hard

items.name: 10.2 Stacks & Queues
items.description:
Learning Outcomes: Implement stack and queue using arrays and linked lists.
Time Commitment: 8-10 hours
Difficulty: Hard

items.name: 10.3 Trees & Graphs (Intro)
items.description:
Learning Outcomes: Binary trees, traversals, and graph basics.
Time Commitment: 12-15 hours
Difficulty: Hard
